verdict.rationale: Jules explicitly runs in a cloud VM that clones code and installs dependencies, isolated from the user's local machine, with a plan-review step before code changes are made — directly matching the sandboxed execution story. Community reports corroborate it actually running tasks end-to-end (producing PRs) in this VM environment, though some criticize reliability/loops on complex codebases. Missing for 10: detailed docs on sandbox security boundaries (network isolation, resource limits) and independent security audit of the VM isolation.
